title: Van S NDE 8600
content: I stopped to help at a car accident near my office. When I lifted a fallen street light from roof of one of the cars, I was seriously shocked by light pole. I went flying backwards in air and was traveling at very high speed through a dark tunnel. As I was moving the spot of light at the end of the tunnel grew in size. Then, I was in a large vaulted room with rays of light with golden specks that were suspended in the air like large dust particles. I saw hundreds of people standing around me. My recently deceased mother and my maternal grandmother were with them. I looked them in the eyes and felt at peace. I was led from the room to the outside. It was like an open campus area in vibrant light. I was led to a figure sitting on a stone. The stone was an elevated throne with steps leading up to it. I received a message, but can't remember what it was. Suddenly, I begin to fall rapidly through the dark. Below me, I could see a point of light that kept growing as I got closer to it. I could see it was a street light. I could also see my body lying face down in a pool of blood. I went from feeling light and in no pain to feeling heavy and in intense pain from my injuries. I rolled over and tried to get up. A security guard told me not to move. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: March 1990 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I had a fFeeling of euphoria and enlightenment. I was loved. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Yes Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. Time sped up. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was night time and after the accident it was well-lit with rays of light in the vaulted room. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Hearing was muted. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes It was dark in the tunnel as I watched the point of light approaching Did you see any beings in your experience? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I saw my mother and grandmother. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes I saw intense rays that had golden-colored flakes that were floating around the rays Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt euphoria, enlightenment, and love Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe. I was given a secret that I can no longer remember. Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Protestant Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Protestant Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Seeing strangers with my mom and grandmother. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Uncertain I was led by someone to be addressed by someone at the side of the throne. During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes I cannot remember the message. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes A figure sitting on a throne. I felt no fear while it addressing me Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I cannot remember the knowledge, but do remember that I was happy. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists. I saw departed souls who were happy and gathered in a room Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about love? Uncertain What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. Harder to relate to daily work-related tasks. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Relationship with wife was damaged. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Very accurate. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes To wife in emergency room. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. Revisiting accident site What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. I always remember experience. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Occasionally I have seen a dark figure. Recently I saw it twice outdoors. I also saw it immeditately after my sister had just died. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: A figure was "sitting on a stone" described as an "elevated throne with steps leading up to it."

environment.environment_other_detail: Large vaulted room with rays of light and golden specks suspended in the air; later "like an open campus area in vibrant light."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Electrical shock from lifting a fallen street light/light pole at a car accident scene.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/separation with loss of body awareness, rapid travel through a dark tunnel toward a growing light, arrival in a vaulted room with many people including deceased relatives, then led outside to a throne/figure and received an unremembered message; then rapid falling back through darkness to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Later report: "Occasionally I have seen a dark figure... I also saw it immediately after my sister had just died."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was traveling at very high speed through a dark tunnel."; "large vaulted room with rays of light with golden specks"; "I was led to a figure sitting on a stone... an elevated throne with steps leading up to it."; "I went from feeling light and in no pain to feeling heavy and in intense pain."
